metadata.title: Best Real Estate Data APIs for Building a Deal Finder App
metadata.author: REI Tech Club
metadata.shortDescription:
In this video, I take you behind the scenes of my journey to build an AI-powered deal-finding app for real estate investing. The concept is simple: scan active listings, apply my buy box, and get the best deals in my inbox every day. But the biggest challenge? Finding a reliable, legal data source—without a real estate license or access to the MLS.

I started with the obvious options like Zillow and Redfin, but scraping them is a legal minefield. I explored official MLS APIs, but most of them require licensing, bureaucracy, and enterprise-level partnerships. So I had to keep going.

Eventually, I filtered down dozens of data providers to just a few that seemed transparent, investor-friendly, and easy to work with. In the end, I chose Rentcast—a tool with open API documentation, clear pricing, and solid national coverage, even if it isn’t a direct MLS feed.

This is the first step in building a smarter real estate tool—and a smarter investing system—with AI. If you’re a solo investor or builder looking to leverage tech in your real estate strategy, this channel is for you.

Subscribe to stay updated on the build, or join the REI + AI newsletter at: https://reiplusai.com/

For business inquiries, contact: ben@reiplusai.com
